say: Mirela: Spirlings are born here, at the edge of drawing. They wander out and find a person.
Mirela: When that bond breaks, they call. And the call comes back here.
Mirela: All those calls became one voice. The Echo. It isn't cruel. It's grieving.
Mirela: When it gets too loud it leaks out through the Rifts. That's your Hush.
The grey at the edge of the map rises like a wave. Shapes in it. Spirlings, hushed and lost.
